name: International Summer School for Young Physicists (ISSYP)
column22: Confirmed via search: research-focused theoretical physics program for HS students. Grade eligibility (11-12) is my best estimate, not directly confirmed - CHECK official page. Stipend/cost not confirmed.

name: Sanofi Biogenius Canada
notes: Real national biotech research competition - students do ~4 months of mentored research then present regionally/nationally. Found via Wikipedia, not their own site - DO NOT USE ANY URL UNTIL THE OFFICIAL DOMAIN IS CONFIRMED. Grade range is an estimate.

name: DEEP Summer Academy
notes: Confirmed via search incl. official URL. This is enrichment coursework (advanced classes taught by grad students), NOT independent research - flag if you want research-only entries. Cost not confirmed (likely paid by student/family, need to check).

name: NSERC Undergraduate Student Research Awards (USRA)
org: Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada
notes: Confirmed via search: $6000 NSERC + $1500 min top-up = $7500 total, 16 weeks May-Sept. Canadian citizen/PR required. isDirectory=true because students apply through an individual professor/university, not one central application. levels: excludes first-year (2+ terms completed required) - ugrad-1 kept in for now since some students start research awards early in year 2, VERIFY this cutoff before shipping.

name: Science Undergraduate Research Experience (SURE) Awards
notes: Confirmed via search incl. official URL. 8+ weeks, up to $3500, open to domestic AND international BSc/BCS students at UBC Vancouver campus. Must reside in BC during award.

name: Science Undergraduate Research Awards (SURA)
notes: Confirmed via search incl. official URL. 15 weeks full-time, $9050 stipend (2026 figure), open to Canadian AND international McGill students - broader eligibility than NSERC USRA.

name: Undergraduate Research Assistantship (URA) - Computer Science
org: University of Waterloo (Cheriton School of CS)
notes: Confirmed via search incl. official URL. 10 weeks, PART-TIME during a study term (not summer-only like the others) - availability set to year-round to reflect this, VERIFY this modeling choice. Stipend amount not confirmed. Requires faculty supervisor + GPA threshold that varies by department - this record is CS-specific; Engineering has its own URA with different eligibility (80% GPA, specific terms) that should probably be a SEPARATE row.

name: Mitacs Globalink Research Internship
notes: IMPORTANT: confirmed via search this is for INTERNATIONAL students only (eligible countries incl. Brazil, China, France, Germany, Mexico, UK, US, etc.) - NOT open to Canadian citizens/PRs applying as Canadians. Only include this if Researchly matches US/international students to Canadian programs; exclude or heavily flag if the Canada batch is meant for Canadian users only. 12-week internship, deadline shown is for the 2027 cycle (Sept 16 2026) per search result - re-verify before using.

name: Shad Canada
notes: Well-known program, but URL not directly confirmed in this session's searches (shad.ca is my best-confidence recall, not a clicked/verified source this round) - CONFIRM before shipping. STEAM + entrepreneurship challenge, not pure research - similar caveat to DEEP. Highly selective, month-long, residential.
